title: Where can you fly direct from Dublin Airport?
author: Brogan
intro: Dublin is the biggest airport on the island of Ireland, with around 150 destinations in winter and direct flights to North America and the Gulf. Ryanair and Aer Lingus fly most routes. Here's what flies, what has changed and how to choose.
seo_title: Where can you fly direct from Dublin? (2026 guide)
seo_description: Ryanair and Aer Lingus fly most routes, with direct flights to the US, Canada and the Gulf. What flies, what's changed for winter 2026 and how to choose.

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
- **Main airlines:** Ryanair and Aer Lingus
- **Destinations:** about 150 in winter
- **Long-haul:** USA, Canada and the Gulf
- **US flights:** preclearance in Dublin
- **Gone this winter:** Denver and Las Vegas

We checked these routes in November 2026. Routes and days of the week change every season, so check the airline's timetable before you plan a trip around one.

sections.heading: Who flies from Dublin
sections.text:
Ryanair is the biggest airline at Dublin, flying from Terminal 1 to cities and beaches all over Europe. Aer Lingus, Ireland's national airline, flies from Terminal 2 to Europe and North America. Last winter the airport listed about 150 destinations served by around 40 airlines, so most of Europe is a direct flight away.

The long-haul choice is the big difference from regional airports. As well as Aer Lingus, US airlines such as United, Delta and American fly across the Atlantic, some only in summer, and Emirates, Qatar Airways and Etihad fly to the Gulf, where you can connect onwards to Asia, Africa and Australia.

sections.heading: Flight times from Dublin
sections.text:
| Destination | Typical airlines | Flight time |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Paris](/destinations/paris) | Ryanair, Aer Lingus | about 1 hr 45 |
| [Rome](/destinations/rome) | Ryanair, Aer Lingus | about 3 hrs |
| [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife) | Ryanair, Aer Lingus | about 4 hrs 15 |
| [New York](/destinations/new-york) | Aer Lingus, US airlines | about 7 hrs 30 |
| [Dubai](/destinations/dubai) | Emirates | about 7 hrs 30 |

Times are approximate and vary with wind and the airport you land at. Flights west to North America take longer than the flight home, often by an hour or more.

sections.heading: North America
sections.text:
Dublin has more direct transatlantic flights than any other airport in Ireland. Aer Lingus flies to US cities including [New York](/destinations/new-york), [Boston](/destinations/boston), [Chicago](/destinations/chicago), [Orlando](/destinations/orlando), [Los Angeles](/destinations/los-angeles) and [San Francisco](/destinations/san-francisco), and there are flights to [Toronto](/destinations/toronto) in Canada.

US Customs and Border Protection runs preclearance at Dublin for US-bound flights. You go through US immigration before you board, then land in America as a domestic passenger. It saves queues at the other end, but it means you need to get to the airport earlier. Our guide to [how early to arrive at Dublin Airport](/blog/how-early-should-you-arrive-at-dublin-airport) covers how much time to allow.

Watch out: you still need an approved ESTA (or a visa) before flying to the US, and preclearance can turn you away at Dublin if your paperwork isn't in order.

sections.heading: What has changed for winter 2026/27
sections.text:
Aer Lingus announced cuts to its North American network in July 2026, part of a wider plan to reduce its flying:

- **Denver:** ended after September 2026.
- **Minneapolis–St. Paul:** ended in late October 2026.
- **Las Vegas:** ends after early December 2026.
- **Seattle:** now summer-only, so no flights this winter.

There is some new flying too. United plans to fly from Washington Dulles to Dublin with its new long-range Airbus A321XLR from 1 December 2026, adding to its other flights to [Washington](/destinations/washington-dc). Aer Lingus was also reported to be pausing some European routes this winter, including Frankfurt, Hamburg and Malta, so check before you book.

sections.heading: Winter sun and city breaks
sections.text:
For winter sun, the Canaries are the warmest choice within about four and a half hours, with direct flights to [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife), [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote), [Gran Canaria](/destinations/gran-canaria) and [Fuerteventura](/destinations/fuerteventura). [Málaga](/destinations/malaga), the [Algarve](/destinations/algarve) and [Madeira](/destinations/madeira) are milder options for walking and city days.

For a weekend away, Ryanair and Aer Lingus between them fly to most of Europe's big cities, including [Amsterdam](/destinations/amsterdam), [Barcelona](/destinations/barcelona), [Lisbon](/destinations/lisbon), [Prague](/destinations/prague) and [Kraków](/destinations/krakow). Further afield, Aer Lingus launched a winter route to [Cancún](/destinations/cancun) in January 2026, and [Tromsø](/destinations/tromso) was new last winter for the northern lights.

Tip: Ryanair and Aer Lingus fly from different terminals. Check which one before you leave home, especially if someone is dropping you off.

sections.heading: Where could you go from Dublin?
sections.text:
For a winter weekend, try [Paris](/destinations/paris), [Prague](/destinations/prague) or [Amsterdam](/destinations/amsterdam). For a week of sun, look at [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife) or [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote). For a big trip, [New York](/destinations/new-york), [Orlando](/destinations/orlando) and [Dubai](/destinations/dubai) are all direct. The [holidays in the USA](/destinations/holidays-in-the-usa) and [city breaks](/destinations/city-breaks) pages have more ideas.

If your family can't agree, read our guide to [deciding where to go on holiday](/how-to-decide-where-to-go-on-holiday), or add a few ideas to somewhere.party and let the draw decide.

faqs.question: Which airlines fly from Dublin Airport?
faqs.answer: Ryanair and Aer Lingus fly the most routes. Around 40 airlines fly from Dublin in winter, including US airlines, Emirates, Qatar Airways and Etihad.

faqs.question: Can you fly direct from Dublin to America?
faqs.answer: Yes. Aer Lingus and US airlines fly direct to cities including New York, Boston, Chicago and Orlando, and you clear US immigration in Dublin before you board.

faqs.question: Does Aer Lingus still fly from Dublin to Las Vegas?
faqs.answer: Not for long. Aer Lingus said its Dublin to Las Vegas route ends after early December 2026, and Denver and Minneapolis have already stopped.

faqs.question: Can you fly direct from Dublin to Dubai?
faqs.answer: Yes. Emirates flies direct from Dublin to Dubai, and Etihad and Qatar Airways fly to Abu Dhabi and Doha.
